answer: We formulate a dynamic opportunity-cost bond mechanism with a subgame-perfect punishment matrix, requiring staking collateral to anchor cryptoeconomic security. Any malicious actor harboring an umber of duplicated identities faces an insurmountable capital barrier, as strategic Sybil multiplication triggers a severe mesa of slashing penalties.
